verdict.rationale: Automatic suppression of unsubscribes, bounces and spam complaints is a core, applicable axis for an email marketing platform, but nothing in the evidence pack documents it. The only nearby item is the ability to search contacts by 'status', which is an adjacent contact-management feature, not documented suppression honored across every send type.

support.subject: As an ops user, unsubscribes, bounces, and spam complaints are suppressed automatically and honored across every send type — CAN-SPAM/GDPR hygiene by default
